theses.subject: Coal

The one-narrative structure concentrates leadership here, and crowding is absent (crowded=false, z 0.59). But the absolute-trend gate does not help on this market's backtest, and mean-revert hurst tag suggests the trend itself may be fragile — ownership is conditional on it holding through the check-by date, not on the rank.
theses.dissent: Hurst tag is mean-revert and the backtest explicitly says the trend gate whipsaws on this market's mean-reverting tape — so the leading theme may reverse without warning, and the detector's own verdict says relative momentum has no alpha.
